mutations.label: flag-sweep: an unchanged flag surface reports nothing
mutations.from: for (const f of a) if (!b.has(f)) out.add(f)
mutations.only: ^(?:a flag added to the surface is reported, and an unchanged surface is not|a flag removed from the surface is reported too|a flag whose line moved is not a flag whose surface changed)$

mutations.label: flag-sweep: a flag removed from the surface is still a change
mutations.from: for (const f of b) if (!a.has(f)) out.add(f)
mutations.to: for (const f of b) if (false) out.add(f)
mutations.only: ^(?:a flag removed from the surface is reported too)$

mutations.label: flag-sweep: the backlog is history, not prose this project serves
mutations.only: ^(?:history is not served prose, and skills are)$

mutations.label: flag-sweep: a gate name is matched whole, not as a substring
mutations.only: ^(?:a gate name is matched whole, so prose about another tool does not qualify)$
